name: sl
source: Softmax loss (SL) as implemented in the DrRL authors' repository, github.com/cynthia-shengjia/AAAI-2025-DrRL @ faacdbc (optimizer/optim_Softmax.py), with the same cosine scores, 1024 uniform negatives and sampler as the DrRL adapter. A tuned reference, not a denoising method: DrRL's gain over it separates the Renyi margin from the change of loss.
grid_source: The paper's Table 8 SL settings: temperature tau 0.07 to 0.26 and learning rate 1e-2 to 1e-1 across its 12 cases. 8-trial budget: lr_mult {1, 10} x tau {0.08, 0.12, 0.2, 0.25}; lr_mult multiplies the plain model's tuned learning rate. Our choice, read from Table 8 (appendix ranges not in our copy of the paper).
memory: as DrRL (1024 negatives per positive); no per-user margin
